pages.text: $(o)And what is above has its opposite.$(br2)In another dungeon of the lowest layer, also around depth -45, the demon knights wait.

The infernal stone will come from there.$(br2)With the two stones, two inner arches will rise inside the Portal's arch. The Receptacle will return as the Receptacle of the Depths: its window will say how many of each stone it needs.
